name: dam-sluice
description: M4 Phase 3b scenario (epic #163; objects beyond the house): the Flood Control Dam #3 sluice gates. Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000, zone UTC, microseconds 0); unmodified pinned sources, START seeds RANDOM from DSKDATE, no RANDOM override and no seed search. The first sixteen commands are troll-combat's (the sword kills the troll at the third blow under this clock and seed), then `north` to the East-West Passage, `north` to the Deep Ravine, `down` to Reservoir South, `up` to the Deep Canyon, `east` to the Dam, `north` to the Dam Lobby and `north` to the Maintenance Room (the Loud Room route through the Echo Room is avoided: ECHO-ROOM reads its own input without a prompt). `take wrench`, back to the Dam, `turn bolt with wrench` refused ("The bolt won't turn with your best effort.": GATE-FLAG unset), back to the Maintenance Room, `push yellow button` ("Click.", GATE-FLAG T), back to the Dam, `look` (the green bubble glows), `turn bolt with wrench` (BOLT-FUNCTION 77act1.mud:701: "The sluice gates open and water pours through the dam.", LOW-TIDE T, the trunk made visible), `look`, `south`, `nw` to the drained reservoir, `look`, `take trunk`, `north` across the reservoir bed (the LOW-TIDE exit) and `score`. Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference (captured twice, byte-identical transcripts). NATIVE REFERENCE ONLY, not a gated scenario: this runtime stops at command 23 on entering the Maintenance Room (MAINT-ROOM's attached #DECL names the undefined type PRSOBJ; INV-11). Tracked as an expected failure by tests/historical_dam_frontier_test.rkt (make xfail-m4-dam-frontier); see docs/evidence/M4/DAM-CLOCKS.md. Input ends after `score` (D3 end-of-input applies).
